content.text: Perfect! I found that "CHIRURGIE DENTAIRE" (dental surgery) has PSE_ACT_SNDS = 19. Now let me query the reimbursements data to get the total amount charged before reimbursement, grouped by processing month:

input.sql:
SELECT 
  FLX_ANN_MOI AS month_yyyymm,
  SUM(PRS_ACT_COG) AS total_charged
FROM ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS
WHERE PSE_ACT_SNDS = 19
GROUP BY FLX_ANN_MOI
ORDER BY FLX_ANN_MOI

content.text: Perfect! I have the answer. The query shows the total amount charged (PRS_ACT_COG) for care whose executing provider's activity is "CHIRURGIE DENTAIRE" (dental surgery), grouped by processing month in YYYYMM format and sorted chronologically.

input.final_sql:
SELECT 
  FLX_ANN_MOI AS month,
  SUM(PRS_ACT_COG) AS total_charged
FROM ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS
WHERE PSE_ACT_SNDS = 19
GROUP BY FLX_ANN_MOI
ORDER BY FLX_ANN_MOI
